rationale: All four P0 acceptance criteria are FULL-covered by 18 backend integration tests in src/backend/tests/dashboard_tests.rs (10 from initial implementation + 8 from automation expansion). Backend dashboard suite executed 10/10 green during implementation; high-risk regression suites (team_tests, project_pl_tests, cash_flow_dashboard_tests, ctc_validation_report_tests, compliance_audit_report_tests = 132/132) re-ran green. Data isolation, sensitive-field guards, list bounds, empty-state, and security-boundary tests are all present. Decision is PASS_WITH_ADVISORY because the frontend Leptos /dashboard page has only compile-level verification (no committed component/E2E harness exists in the repo), 30-second polling is intentionally deferred to Story 6.2, and the login.rs redirect change has no automated frontend test. None of these are release-blocking — the backend is the authority for role scope per Story 6.1 architecture compliance.
advisory_gaps: Frontend /dashboard rendering has no automated component/E2E coverage; verified by cargo check + Tailwind build only
